name: Ring Racer
summary:
Navigate your jet through narrow canyons at full throttle — hit every ring, beat the clock.

Easy to learn, hard to master.

And you never fly alone: your co-pilot Squeezie is always at your side.

Breathtaking landscapes, beautiful graphics and a soundtrack to match — try not to let them distract you too much.
So what are you waiting for? Take off and become the fly-racing champion with Ring Racer!
